gloss: stuffed to capacity; bulging; packed full

definitions.gloss: stuffed full; bulging; packed to capacity
definitions.explanation: Mimetic word describing something stretched or filled to its limit — a bag packed until it bulges, a stomach so full it is taut, or a schedule with no free slots. Suggests the thing is about to burst or has no more room.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぱんぱんだ。
⟦{荷物|にもつ}→荷物：00737_nimotsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ぱんぱん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧。
examples.english: A bag packed full of stuff.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぱんぱんで、⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{休|やす}む→休む：00606_yasumu⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: My schedule is packed solid and I have no time to rest.

notes:
Casual mimetic word suggesting maximum capacity or fullness. Used with ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ + なる (to become stuffed) or as a prenominal modifier.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ぱんぱん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ — to become completely stuffed/full
- ぱんぱん⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{膨|ふく}らむ→膨らむ：05342_fukuramu⟧ — to swell up / bulge
- ⟦お{腹|なか}→お腹：00805_onaka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぱんぱん — stomach is stuffed (after eating)
- ぱんぱん⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦バッグ→バッグ：00008_baggu⟧ — a jam-packed bag

NOTE: ぱんぱん is also used for a light clapping or patting sound (ぱんぱん⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{叩|たた}く→叩く：02072_tataku⟧ — to clap), though the 'stuffed full' meaning is more common in everyday speech.
